apps.name: Terra Incognita
apps.subtitle: The world, and the toys on it
apps.localizedDescription: The whole Earth as satellites saw it this month, and on it a living light for each of the toys: whales off California, starlings in Somerset, a slime mold between Europe's cities, fireflies in the Smokies, a bell struck in Chile, a swell in the Pacific, a river on the Beni, frost on a window at Oymyakon. Touch one and fall into it. Offline; every dataset credited.

apps.subtitle: Your finger is warm
